<script>
(function () {
  if (!/blog/i.test(location.pathname)) return;
  var COLS = 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr))';

  function kids(el){var a=[];for(var c=el.firstElementChild;c;c=c.nextElementSibling)a.push(c);return a;}
  function inChrome(el){return el.closest && el.closest('header,nav,footer');}

  function looksLikeCard(el){
    if(!el||el.nodeType!==1) return false;
    if(!/^(DIV|ARTICLE|LI|A)$/.test(el.tagName)) return false;
    return !!el.querySelector('img,[style*="background-image"]') &&
           !!el.querySelector('h1,h2,h3,h4,p');
  }

  // 1) Known blog card classes, grouped by their parent.
  function byKnownClass(){
    var sels=['.nifty-bl-card','.blog-card','.post-card','.post','.card'];
    var best=null,bestN=0;
    sels.forEach(function(sel){
      var groups=[],counts=[];
      document.querySelectorAll(sel).forEach(function(n){
        var p=n.parentElement; if(!p||inChrome(p)) return;
        var i=groups.indexOf(p); if(i===-1){groups.push(p);counts.push(1);} else counts[i]++;
      });
      for(var i=0;i<groups.length;i++) if(counts[i]>bestN){bestN=counts[i];best=groups[i];}
    });
    return bestN>=2?best:null;
  }

  // 2) Structural fallback for any other template.
  function byStructure(){
    var best=null,bestN=0,all=document.querySelectorAll('div,section,ul,main');
    for(var i=0;i<all.length;i++){
      var p=all[i]; if(inChrome(p)) continue;
      var k=kids(p); if(k.length<2) continue;
      var cards=k.filter(looksLikeCard);
      if(cards.length<2||cards.length<k.length*0.6) continue;
      var tags={}; cards.forEach(function(c){tags[c.tagName]=(tags[c.tagName]||0)+1;});
      if(Math.max.apply(null,Object.keys(tags).map(function(t){return tags[t];}))<2) continue;
      if(cards.length>bestN){bestN=cards.length;best=p;}
    }
    return best;
  }

  function gridify(el){
    el.style.setProperty('display','grid','important');
    el.style.setProperty('grid-template-columns',COLS,'important');
    el.style.setProperty('gap','28px','important');
    el.style.setProperty('align-items','stretch','important');
    el.style.setProperty('width','100%','important');
    el.style.setProperty('max-width','none','important');
    el.style.setProperty('float','none','important');
    kids(el).forEach(function(c){
      c.style.setProperty('width','auto','important');
      c.style.setProperty('max-width','none','important');
      c.style.setProperty('margin','0','important');
      c.style.setProperty('float','none','important');
    });
  }

  // Free the list from a narrow single-child wrapper; keep the centred max-width container.
  function unwrap(list){
    var node=list.parentElement,guard=0;
    while(node && guard++<8){
      if(node.tagName==='BODY'||node.tagName==='MAIN'||node.tagName==='SECTION') break;
      var cs=getComputedStyle(node);
      if(cs.maxWidth && cs.maxWidth!=='none') break;
      if(node.childElementCount>1) break;
      if(cs.display==='grid'||cs.display==='flex'){
        node.style.setProperty('display','block','important');
        node.style.setProperty('grid-template-columns','none','important');
      }
      node.style.setProperty('width','100%','important');
      node.style.setProperty('max-width','none','important');
      node=node.parentElement;
    }
  }

  function run(){
    try{ var list=byKnownClass()||byStructure(); if(list){ unwrap(list); gridify(list); } }catch(e){}
  }
  run();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run);
  window.addEventListener('load',run);
  var q=false;
  new MutationObserver(function(){if(q)return;q=true;requestAnimationFrame(function(){q=false;run();});})
    .observe(document.documentElement,{childList:true,subtree:true});
  var n=0,t=setInterval(function(){run();if(++n>20)clearInterval(t);},300);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  // GA4: Phone call tracking - fires website_calls (existing key event) on all tel: links
  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var link = e.target && e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[href^="tel:"]') : null;
    if (link && typeof gtag === 'function') {
      gtag('event', 'website_calls', {
        phone_number: decodeURIComponent((link.getAttribute('href') || '').replace('tel:', '')).trim(),
        page_location: window.location.href
      });
    }
  });
})();
</script>
